verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's docs and community evidence confirm model fallback lists (priority order, automatic retry on error/rate-limit/down), provider-selection routing rules, load balancing across providers, a 'latest' alias for staying current, and an auto-routing 'meta' model that picks capability-appropriate models to control cost — directly matching policy-based mid-task model switching by cost/capability/availability. missing for 10: no first-party documentation or hands-on evidence of dynamically switching models *within* a single in-flight task/conversation (vs. per-request fallback/config), and no independent benchmark validating routing-rule reliability in production.
